description: Rent a GPU and pay any USDC shortfall with x402. If spendable USDC already covers budget_micro, the machine is reserved and nothing else is charged. Otherwise this returns the x402 requirements for the shortfall only. The payment is credited like a deposit, then the rental is reserved once that credit is spendable. The same idempotency_key never reserves twice, and the same payment cannot settle twice. Mainnet (eip155:8453) is offered only when the operator set X402_MAINNET_ENABLED. Base Sepolia is eip155:84532 (EIP-712 name USDC). Solana is not accepted. Write tool: refused unless the server was started with AMPLERUN_MCP_ALLOW_SPEND=1 (the default is read-only).

budget_micro.description: Spending cap in micro-units of the asset ("1000000" = 1 USDC). The rental is never charged more than this.

duration_limit_s.description: Maximum runtime in seconds (60 to 31536000), e.g. 7200 for two hours.

idempotency_key.description: UUID that makes retries safe. Generated when omitted and returned in the result.

ssh_public_key.description: Optional one-line OpenSSH public key. Omit for model or API usage; SSH stays off.

template.description: Template slug such as "pytorch-cuda", or its id (UUID), from list_templates.

name: pay_for_rental
title: Pay for a rental (x402 requirements)
